author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
So

The Women World Cup is playing right now (go Japan!!!!) and I decided to make a map out of it

http://imgur.com/a/KeXHq
I just need some help
I have not been at a soccer arena in a while and I need some of your opinions. 

Things i will be doing:
Domed Roof
More Chairs (The Quartz area) as well as making it more steep

Thanks!




ALSOOOOO
The First 10 teams requested will have a flag in the stands in the map Look At: http://www.fifa.com/womensworldcup/teams/ for the teams that u can choose

Current List:
Japan (MEEE + Thunda)
Australia (Petlas)
Canada (Akiyama + Rusha_ + Vlad)
Netherlands (Vo)
Germany (res)
USA (Exclusively)
Switzerland (Ky)
England (Spooks + ImRaging + Nemo + Oscar)

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Also I forgot to put what you do on this map

The goal is to "kick" (hit) the enemies into their goal using Knockback 10 Sticks.
Don't worry you won't die (You have resistance 128)
The Highest Score Wins

The team names are Japan VS USA (2011 Women World Cup Finalist)
